Source: GLPI App Structure ID 797 + Dataflows. Fetched: 2026-06-01.

APPLICATION: SAP ERP EMEA
GLPI ID: 797
TYPE: OnPremise
STATUS: In Use
DEVELOPMENT LANGUAGE: .Net
DATABASE: SQL Server
INSTANCES: Integration+QA+Prod
OWNER: OMDS IT > OMDG > SAP ERP
SUPPLIER: SAP Deutschland SE & Co. KG
TARGETS: Strategic
SERVICE LEVEL: Critical 24x7
LOCATION: Coimbra

ROLE IN ARCHITECTURE:
SAP ERP EMEA is the core ERP system for OMDS European operations. It is a central hub for financial, logistics, and order management processes, integrating with warehouse management (CANCOM), expense management (SAP Concur), e-commerce (Mulesoft/Magento), document archiving (Easy Archive), Portuguese tax authority (PT-AT), and the BIBU data platform.

INBOUND DATAFLOWS (systems feeding INTO SAP ERP EMEA - 12 flows):
- CANCOM -> SAP ERP EMEA: [CANCOM]-[SAP-ERP] SO Create (ID: 99)
- CANCOM -> SAP ERP EMEA: [CANCOM]-[SAPERP] Goods Mvmt (ID: 18)
- CANCOM -> SAP ERP EMEA: [CANCOM]-[SAPERP] Pick_List_Report (ID: 13)
- SAP Concur -> SAP ERP EMEA: [CONCUR]-[SAP-ERP] CREATE EXPENSES (ID: 117)
- IT Tools -> SAP ERP EMEA: [ITTOOL]-[SAP-ERP] CPD_GET_STOCK (ID: 233)
- IT Tools -> SAP ERP EMEA: [ITTOOL]-[SAP-ERP] ORDER_PGI (ID: 232)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] Customer Create or Update (ID: 123)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] N/A (ID: 124)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] Order Create (ID: 20)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] Order Status (ID: 259)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] Return Create (ID: 125)
- PayPal -> SAP ERP EMEA: [PAYPAL]-[SAPERP] B2C Payment Info (ID: 181)

OUTBOUND DATAFLOWS (SAP ERP EMEA distributes TO - 18 flows):
- SAP ERP EMEA -> Bank: [SAP-ERP]-[BANK] PAYMENTS (ID: 207)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> CANCOM: [SAP-ERP]-[CANCOM] Invoice (ID: 100)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> CANCOM: [SAPERP]-[CANCOM] Expected_Receipt_Show (ID: 9)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> CANCOM: [SAPERP]-[CANCOM] ItemMasterShow (ID: 12)

- SAP ERP EMEA -> Easy Archive: [SAP-ERP]-[EASY] BILLING PDF (ID: 114)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> Easy Archive: [SAP-ERP]-[EASY] DELNOTE PDF (ID: 115)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> Easy Archive: [SAP-ERP]-[EASY] INVOICE PDF (ID: 116)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> ExDB: [SAP-ERP]-[ExDB] CUSTOMER (ID: 110)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> ExDB: [SAP-ERP]-[ExDB] ITEM (ID: 109)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> ExDB: [SAP-ERP]-[ExDB] SALES DELIVERY (ID: 113)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> ExDB: [SAP-ERP]-[ExDB] SALES ORDER (ID: 112)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> PT-AT: [SAP-ERP]-[PT-AT] ATCUD CODE (ID: 122)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> PT-AT: [SAP-ERP]-[PT-AT] CERT TOKEN (ID: 120)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> PT-AT: [SAP-ERP]-[PT-AT] SAFT (ID: 119)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> PT-AT: [SAP-ERP]-[PT-AT] TRANSPORT CERT (ID: 121)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> BIBU: [SAPERP_NEP]-[SL_SAPERP] Extraction (ID: 263)

KEY INTEGRATIONS:
- CANCOM: Warehouse management - 5 flows (goods movements, sales orders, invoices, item master)
- Mulesoft: E-commerce bridge - 5 flows (orders, returns, customers from Magento)
- Easy Archive: Document archiving - 3 flows (billing, delivery notes, invoices as PDFs)
- PT-AT: Portuguese tax authority compliance - 4 flows (SAFT, ATCUD, certificates)
- ExDB: Internal data store - 4 flows (customer, item, sales order, delivery)
- BIBU: Data platform extraction - 1 flow feeding the source layer (SL_SAPERP)
- PayPal: B2C payment integration - 1 inbound flow
